title: Adversarial Example Does Good: Preventing Painting Imitation from Diffusion Models via Adversarial Examples

layout.note: Two titled bands stacked: the top one holds two left-to-right lanes (clean photo in a green frame, adversarial photo in a red frame) through a classifier to a probability bar chart and a verdict; the lower one has a grey rounded box on textual inversion above two lanes that extract a condition, put it in a prompt and generate, with braces naming the stages.

lesson: Draw the clean and the attacked case as two lanes through the same model and colour everything that belongs to a lane (photo frame, bar, tick or cross, star, even the slot letter in the prompt) green or red, ending the red lane in a visibly broken output. Add one grey zoom box above the stage that needs explaining.
